purpose: Teach: 高架/岩石/邸宅/蜘蛛/蝉/コスモス/重油/広辞苑

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが高架の橋を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you the elevated bridge.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Soft opening. Gentle pace—she's inviting him into something nice. Slight lift at the end, like passing along a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、岩石の標本を学校で見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw rock samples at school.
lines.style: Bright and direct, the quick rush of a child who found something worth sharing. No hesitation. Eager to tell her everything he noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが古い邸宅の絵を描かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, I painted a picture of an old mansion.
lines.style: Quiet pride in her own work. Reflective pace. She's sharing something personal—let him see she does things too. Slight warmth, inviting his attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お庭で蜘蛛を観察したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a spider in the garden.
lines.style: Small, focused enthusiasm. He's reporting his own careful observation—not loud, but certain. The tone of someone who notices things others miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夏は蝉の合唱が聴こえるわね
lines.en: Sho, in summer you can hear the cicadas singing, can't you.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia. Even pacing. She's painting a season for him, not lecturing. The trailing statement invites him to feel it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんとコスモス畑に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to a cosmos field with Mom.
lines.style: Soft, satisfied delivery. He's reporting something beautiful he experienced. Not boasting—sharing a moment. Slight contentment in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが重油のお仕事のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me about his work with heavy oil.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle. She's bridging his world and the adult world. Measured pace. There's respect in how she shares this—not dismissing his father's work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、家で広辞苑を引くのを学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned how to look up words in the Kojien at home.
lines.style: Quiet pride in a real accomplishment. Careful, deliberate delivery—he's proud of the effort, not just the result. Slight breathiness on the verb, like he's still discovering his own capability.
